version.changelog: Moved to vmware-skills GitHub org; MCP Registry namespace → io.github.vmware-skills. Links updated.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed, read-only VMware log-querying integration with expected credential and audit-file handling.

dimensions.detail: The skill needs network access to the configured Log Insight appliance and credentials for that appliance; this is proportionate to log search but can expose sensitive operational log data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a uv tool package and local config files under ~/.vmware-log-insight; this is normal for the integration but users should verify the package source before installing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime guidance keeps use scoped to VMware log investigations, warns that log text is untrusted, requires bounded searches, and routes unrelated VMware tasks to other skills.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It records read calls in ~/.vmware/audit.db and stores configuration/credential material locally, including a disclosed first-load password obfuscation rewrite; no cron, startup task, sudo, destructive action, or write-capable appliance tool was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to search and aggregate VMware Aria Operations for Logs data, and the documented MCP/CLI tools are consistently described as read-only log, metadata, and alert-history queries.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let the agent read VMware Log Insight data. Use a least-privilege read-only service account, keep ~/.vmware-log-insight/.env protected or inject secrets from a secret manager, and leave TLS verification enabled except for controlled lab appliances.
llm.findings:
[PE2] expected: The flagged chmod 600 text is local file-permission guidance for protecting the .env file, not sudo/root execution or privilege escalation.
[PE3] expected: The .env reference is disclosed credential loading for authenticating to the configured Log Insight appliance; users are told to prefer secret-manager injection for stronger at-rest secrecy.
[RA2] expected: The flagged config and audit database files are disclosed setup/audit state for this integration, not hidden background persistence or an unauthorized long-running worker.
